title: pm-dispatch(contract-review): a contract-review FAIL on the current head disarms auto-merge at once; #27667 landed 20 minutes after its delta FAIL and turned main red (p0 #27806)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Filing gate ① — a process gap measured on the board. The fault is in the skills, as the maintainer ruled for this family on #27345 (「PR 欠契约复审就合入也还是技能的问题」). ⛔ Not a claim. Grading and lane are triage's; the change is under `.claude/**` (Tier H), so this seat does not touch it.

## What happened (measured)

| Event | Comment / run | Time |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Seat check after a main merge moved the head to `af33de9c`; auto-merge stays armed from the earlier ACCEPT | `6510205555` on PR #27667 | 2026-10-29T22:41Z |
| Triage: auto-merge is armed on a head no PASS names; the owning seat disarms it until a delta PASS | `6510422663` | 2026-10-29T22:54Z |
| Delta contract review on `af33de9c`: **FAIL**, two must-fix (two dogfood pins assert the old wire) | `6510686343` | 2026-10-29T23:11Z |
| PR #27667 merges at `af33de9c` through the still-armed auto-merge | merge commit `21c4bdd8` | 2026-10-29T23:31Z |
| main `Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)` red on exactly the two pins the FAIL named | run `40973741934`, p0 #27806 | after the merge |

Nothing between the FAIL record and the merge removed the PR from the queue. The FAIL was posted on the PR; auto-merge had been armed by the seat's ACCEPT on an earlier head.

## The gap

`contract-review.md` and the #27345 fix say a PASS must name the current head before landing, and that a seat must not arm a PR before that. They do not say what happens to a PR that is **already armed** when the review on its current head comes back **FAIL**, or when a main merge moves the head after arming. Nobody is told to disarm, so the queue lands the FAIL head. (The merge-group run also skipped the dogfood shards for this diff; that filter-parity blind spot is #27806's follow-up and not this card's.)

## Wanted (route is triage's)

1. **A FAIL disarms.** When a contract-review record on the PR's current head is FAIL, auto-merge is disabled at once (relay `automerge_disable` or the queue's dequeue), by the reviewer that posts the FAIL, or by the owning seat on its next event if the reviewer cannot write that op. Re-arming needs a PASS naming the new head.
2. **A moved head disarms.** When a seat's ACCEPT names a head that is no longer the PR's head (a main merge that changes the reviewed surface), the owning seat disarms until a delta PASS or a `Regen-provenance:` line names the new head. This is what triage asked of the seat in `6510422663`; it should be a written rule, not a one-off note.
3. Whether a mechanical backstop (a queue guard that refuses a head whose newest contract record is FAIL) is also wanted is the maintainer's call: #27345 chose the skills remedy over a queue gate, so this card does not assume one.

Links: PR #27667, #27597, p0 #27806, #27345.
